item: Row J J3: the seeder registers a source per (domain, feed); the shadowed catalogue falls from 475 entries to 19 unregistered, each named with a reason
summary: Measured on the production seeder capture: a fresh install registers 6,411 rows (was 6,195); 240 entries merge their tags onto the row that claims the same outlet or feed (235 feed-less + 5 same-feed, R145 amendment); 19 stay unregistered (feed-less duplicates of feed-less hosts plus the ruled legal collapse); 189 of the 192 lean tags the shadowing lost are recovered through the merge and the other 3 sit on rows of their own. A merged tag never overwrites a different value (a conflicting lean is counted and listed with both sources) and is merged once per row, so a tag an operator removed stays removed. A new sibling row inherits the outlet's oldest measured verdict as an inherited attempt plus its admission audit. Add and import paths match on (domain, feed) so a round trip of a thirty-feed outlet no longer overwrites its first row thirty times; the sources list shows the feed.
